entries.name: Blendshape Sync
entries.outcome: Initial linked blendshape weights transfer; live synchronization does not.
entries.reason: Animator-curve propagation and runtime parameter changes are not converted.
entries.summary: Initial weights only. No live sync.

entries.name: Bone Proxy
entries.outcome: Supported bone/path attachment and scale behavior transfer.
entries.reason: Requires a resolvable target in the owning avatar.
entries.summary: Bone or path attachment, with supported scale behavior.

entries.name: Material Setter
entries.outcome: Supported initial material-slot assignments transfer; live changes do not.
entries.reason: Requires exact renderer and material identities; unresolved context is reported rather than guessed.
entries.summary: Initial material slots only. No live changes.

entries.name: Menu Item
entries.outcome: Some menu context informs initial appearance; no usable menu is installed.
entries.reason: Only safely resolvable initial reactive context is evaluated. Full menu and parameter translation remain missing.
entries.summary: Initial context only. No usable menu.

entries.name: Merge Armature
entries.outcome: Matching outfit bones map to the target; unmatched bones stay with the outfit.
entries.reason: Structural merge only; this does not imply support for other outfit components.
entries.summary: Matching bones merge; unmatched bones stay.

entries.name: Object Toggle
entries.outcome: Supported initial visibility transfers; interactive toggles do not.
entries.reason: Reactive defaults must resolve safely; no runtime parameter system is recreated.
entries.summary: Initial visibility only. No interactive toggle.

entries.name: Shape Changer
entries.outcome: Supported initial Set weights transfer; deletion and live control do not.
entries.reason: Only reversible initial appearance is evaluated; ambiguous reactive context can block application.
entries.summary: Initial Set weights only. No deletion or live control.

entries.name: Apply During Upload
entries.outcome: Supported reversible static actions transfer into initial appearance.
entries.reason: Only the implemented initial-action subset is evaluated, not arbitrary actions or runtime behavior.

entries.name: Armature Link
entries.outcome: Supported recursive merges and single-bone attachments transfer.
entries.reason: Target bones, offset paths and supported transform options must resolve.
entries.summary: Supported bone merge and attachment modes.

entries.name: Blend Shape Link
entries.outcome: Initial linked blendshape weights transfer; live synchronization does not.
entries.reason: Runtime parameter behavior and animator-curve propagation are not converted.
entries.summary: Initial weights only. No live sync.

entries.name: Toggle
entries.outcome: Supported authored resting appearance transfers; the interactive toggle does not.
entries.reason: Dynamic modes and saved runtime state are not inferred. Unsupported contexts are reported.
entries.summary: Resting appearance only. No interactive toggle.
